author: piratewithgun
body:
Dear Avicus Sr. Mods

Last week, I was banned for advertising. This is what happened: I was playing control the hill and asked Tuscaloon in chat whether we could pvp somewhere else. I said we should go to kohi but he said he was banned so I suggested to meet him at play.basicpvp.net. I wrote "see you there" and then I logged on to that server. On returning to Avicus I sadly found out that I had a perm ban. 

I am aware that advertising is not allowed on Avicus but I didn't realise that what I did would count as advertising because I was addressing one player specifically. Also the CTH rot was almost empty. To the best of my memory the only players included myself and Tuscaloon as well as 7h1r733n, blackskittles210 and Eako (who dealt the infraction). I have been that server with 7h1r733n before so the only player that could have been advertised by my message was blackskittles210 who I don't know. 

Before this, I thought that advertising meant going on to a full dtm01 rotation and spamming an ip in chat for 5 mins, and I believe that what I did was relatively harmless and an honest mistake.

I would understand if I had received a warn or even a kick, but I think that it is very harsh to give a perm ban to a player who has been playing on the server for years for putting an ip in chat so that 3 other players could see. 

I am sure that Eako realised that I was just trying to meet up with someone quickly and I wasn't trying to advertise. 

Sorry for breaking the rules, I hope you will appeal me. (If I get appealed, I will use /msg for that in future to stay on the safe side)

4lextr

title: Appeal

replies.author: Javipepe
replies.body:
Hello 4lextr,

We have decided to appeal you due to the fact that we acknowledge that you were clearly not trying to promote said servers in any fashion but just to have a casual encounter with another player on another environment than the ones we offer, which is completely fine; we'd still appreciate if you used /msg next time, as it only matters to you and to said player. You will be appealed, and the infraction will be removed from your profile and from our databases.

Have fun!
Javi
